releaseNotes: The Epigraph doorway: first launch now opens on John 15:5 resolved from the bundled Bible, with a quiet identity line and — beside it — the two languages that go all the way into the life. You can read a full study note for almost any passage even without a connection, cross-references fold in from an offline index, and the daily verse always reads word-for-word from the same Bible the reader shows.
